bounded_tcp.scope: One synchronous immutable Lambda invocation; no retries, remote traffic, EC2, NAT, provisioned concurrency or extra ephemeral storage. Conservative compute/request ceiling plus headroom, not measured charges. Shared orchestration and storage use the separate paper overhead commitment; lifetime storage, taxes and invoice totals are not independently capped.

limitations: Other networking runners remain unapproved. A model or browser cannot add prices. Bounded TCP needs a deployed immutable version and a matching server-owned policy hash; local checks do not verify the deployed configuration.
